Headliner number 6 for GMM 2027!

30 Oct

The second headliner for Friday 18 June! 

Wake me up inside! We’re going to end the week on a high note with the announcement of another heavy hitter for our 30th edition: Evanescence! Ten years after their maiden show here, the band around frontwoman Amy Lee is returning to Graspop Metal Meeting. On Friday 18 June they will headline the South Stage alongside our North Stage headlines Faith No More.

Evanescence forced a worldwide breakthrough with ‘Fallen’, an album that blends heavy guitars, piano melodies and Amy Lee’s instantly recognisable voice. With hits like ‘Bring Me to Life’, ‘My Immortal’ and ‘Going Under’, the American band from Little Rock, Arkansas, rapidly established itself as a household name on the alternative rock and metal scene. On subsequent albums such as ‘The Open Door’ and ‘The Bitter Truth’, Evanescence continued to develop that mix of engaging melodies and powerful guitar work.

Ten years ago Evanescence first set foot on the Dessel plains and last September they rocked Forest National to the rafters with a stunning display of craftsmanship. Next year they are returning to Graspop Metal Meeting for their second performance, as part of our 30th anniversary edition. With ‘Sanctuary’, their sixth studio album released earlier this year, their set list will also include new material. Those who have seen them perform know that classics such as ‘Bring Me to Life’, ‘My Immortal’ and ‘Going Under’ are always among the highlights of the show. On Friday 18 June, Evanescence will close out proceedings on the South Stage.

GMM 2027 - TICKETS 🎫

Tickets for GMM 2027 will go on sale at 10 a.m. on Saturday 14 November through Ticketmaster. Mastercard holders can get their hands on presale tickets between 10 a.m. on Thursday 12 November and 9 a.m. on Saturday 14 November [festival and VIP tickets only]. Go to priceless.com/music for full details.

About GMM: From 17- 20 June 2027 we’re celebrating 30 years of Graspop Metal Meeting. Four days, five stages and the crème de la crème of the international hard rock and metal scene. For the 30th time, Graspop Metal Meeting will shake Dessel to its foundations with monumental mosh pits, piledriving riffs, bludgeoning drums and mind-blowing shows. GMM2027: the anniversary bash no metalhead wants to miss out on.
